summary: The lack of diversity in crop rotations is a factor in the continuous declining of soil health, specially on the macronutrients needs. Moreso, a bad planification in future crops may not provide the best conditions for each of them. This app strives to propose alternative rotations, with essential information about the edaphic properties in the Area of Interest (AOI) and justified data for every suggestion.
details:
The proyects looks for the harmonization of all the information that concerns the rotation crops and its profits. We initially strived for a global harmonic app, however, we observed that a great deal of data was only in U.S., so the idea centralized over that country.

As we concluded that the data was too much to take in, the focus of the proyect shifted to a soil-based analysis, specifically to a nutrient based one, as not all crops have the same needs, or even some give back some of the nutrients taken, as it's a great deal when it comes to which crop the user will sow.

With it, another issue came across: Which of all the properties are the most important to consider? We rounded up to 10 parameters: Soil Taxonomy, pH, Slope, Water table, Soil Hydrologic Group, Drainage Class, Available Water, Organic Matter, Land Capability and Surface Texture.

And a second question: What crops should we focalize our attention? We decided to keep it to the 5 most harvested crops in the U.S.

Alongside the use of Super Intelligence (SI), following studies, we gave a ponderated weight to the different data analysed, and that was then introduced in the SI to write the coding and helping the data management and the graphic interface idea.

It's a suggestion tool, which helps farmers to decide whether the crops grow the best and which rotations crops will help to protect the soil health, giving information about the parameters and how each one of them influence the suggestion in an easy way.

The future idea is to introduce a profit prediction tool with each suggestion, letting the user know that the care of the soil health not only helps the quality of it, but also the quality and yield of the crops. Even more, to introduce more crop rotations that include most of the currently crops harvested alongside the country.

Because of time constraints, the tool is limited to the first 10 parameters mentioned previously, and the 5 top harvested crops.

It is obvious that not only the soil parameters are important, another climatic conditions should be considered, more now than ever because of ever-changing conditions. The harmonization of all the data is an objective to strive to.
